name: Geometric Certificate Translation
description: Replaced the time-based scheduling scenario with a geometric 1D segment packing problem. The impossibility certificates are now defined as geometric packing failures (a single pair of segments failing a left-to-right constraint, or a layer of segments failing a non-overlapping constraint) rather than explicitly stating the arithmetic reductions. This forces the models to independently deduce the arithmetic reductions (`p1+p2 > T` and `sum > T`) from the geometric rules instead of pattern-matching the explicit formulas.
